signature.composition: green plus above separate orange horizontal tag

prompt: One SQUARE flat icon on white for creating a new PLC tag. Show a very large thick GREEN PLUS SIGN in the UPPER half, separate from an equally large horizontal ORANGE TAG in the LOWER half. The tag has a large white hole at its right tip. The plus is not a small badge and does not touch or overlap the tag; it clearly indicates creating a tag. Both shapes must remain recognizable at 30x18. No letters, no border, no shadow; all artwork centered in the middle 70 percent of the square canvas.
